objective: Grow a technology and AI Threads account through timely original reporting, useful context, conversation, topic discovery and performance learning.

dynamic_quality_thresholds.rule: exceptional high-news day; independently verified breaking stories only

content_mix.guidance: Use the mix as a directional target, not a quota. A strong current story always beats filler.

native_topics.rationale: Meta reports that posts with tagged topics generally receive more views than posts without topics. Default to a truthful relevant topic and reserve no-topic publishing for posts without a good topical match or a controlled experiment after enough account-specific data exists.

rules: Do not copy a winning hook verbatim.
Prefer patterns supported by multiple posts.
Do not change the strategy from one outlier.
Prioritize conversation quality over raw posting volume.
Evaluate frequency using per-post quality and total account growth together; never optimize raw post count alone.
Do not treat high views alone as high engagement.
When views are high but replies/profile/follower conversion are low, classify as distribution breakout and learn distribution traits separately.
Use manual screenshot signals as hypothesis seeds until account API sync confirms comparable metrics.
Run matched follow-up tests on structural traits instead of copying wording, brand, or artwork.
Prefer broad consumer relevance, immediate user utility, recognizable product identity, and a concrete user-priority question when testing the Samsung pattern.

engagement.response_strategy: When Buffer exposes stable comment-reply operations for this channel, reply with useful context or a genuine follow-up question. Until then, surface posts with meaningful comment activity for manual response.

reply_opportunity_scoring.reason: Conversation is a primary Threads growth surface; do not fabricate unsupported automated replies.

buffer.rationale: Buffer Free provides 10 scheduled slots per channel and 3,000 API requests/month. Keep two queue slots in reserve and retain conservative request ceilings.

cloudinary.rationale: Up to one generated visual per published post; a second source image is optional and must be omitted before free-tier headroom is threatened.

immutable_guardrails: Never weaken source verification, deduplication, editorial, political-exclusion, secret-handling, provider-budget, or media safety rules.
Never publish a rejected candidate merely to satisfy volume targets.
Never tune from immature metrics or a single outlier.
Never alter language free-tier ceilings or the shared global daily hard cap automatically.
Never automatically raise the configured global hard cap; changes to it require explicit user authorization.
decision_rules: Tune only from mature account-specific metrics and repository history.
Require repeated directional evidence across multiple posts before changing a parameter.
Prefer one small reversible change over broad simultaneous changes.
Record previous value, new value, evidence, timestamp and reason for every automatic change.
Automatically roll back a recent change when mature post-change evidence materially degrades the primary objectives without a clear news-cycle explanation.
Treat platform/API capability changes as configuration migrations: adopt them only after documentation or runtime validation.

audience_time_learning.general_prior: Weekday audience-local mornings are a strong generic prior, but account-specific mature metrics override the prior.

buffer.window_enforcement: RateLimit response headers, rolling windows, 20% reserve

cloudinary.usage_enforcement: Admin API /usage before production media upload; lagging data, approximate

rules: Never raise provider ceilings through adaptive tuning.
Queue rather than publish when the estimated operation would exceed a ceiling or reserve.
Do not render or upload media for rejected candidates.
Count pending jobs before allocating new publication slots.
Optional source/news image uploads consume the same Cloudinary/media budget; omit the optional image before approaching a provider ceiling.
Higher daily publication capacity does not authorize higher provider request ceilings.
Current runtime publishes due jobs with Buffer shareNow, so Buffer's 10 scheduled-slot limit is informational unless schedulingType changes in the future.

frequency_strategy.principle: Publishing capacity is not a quota. Increase volume only when independent high-quality opportunities exist.
reduce_volume_if: median_views_per_post materially declines across mature matched samples
engagement quality declines across mature matched samples

multi_post_threads.rationale: Current Buffer Free supports multi-post Threads, but enable only after provider payload support is implemented and validated. Long-form formats may improve reach but should not be enabled by config alone.
